integrity: An original mathematical claim is distinguished from the previously published ecological motivation and qualitative network-removal experiments. The exact example has a standalone standard-library rational verifier; the universal cutoff is proved analytically. No external independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Static simple bipartite model; independent identically distributed pollinator failures; one perfectly protected pollinator; equal plant richness weights; no cascades, rewiring, heterogeneous costs or empirical calibration. A related 2017 stochastic coextinction work was inspected only in part. An equivalent formulation in broader system-reliability literature has not been ruled out.
title: Sharp five-plant threshold for reentrant pollinator-rescue priorities
